column1: # Template for the next allocation (scripts/campaign.sh replaces {R}). Plan (10-21 21:10, after two allocations of 51 and
# 31 min): prefill with the EAGLE flags from the start (no decode drift); the new policy first (weight 180,000 tokens per
# held request), then weight 0 (= PR 210's token-only decode demand), both with the new router binary, prefill flushed
# before each, measured window 1800 s (10 warm-up requests per lane as canonical) so that a round fits in about an hour.
# A cut round still leaves its decode-balance / step analysis (kit_round.sh partial window). Then the exact PR 210 repro
# (unmodified kit, image router, canonical 3600 s) on a fresh deployment.
run pr210/kit_round.sh RUN=k{R} VARIANT=k{R}-pmtp-w180k CONC=88 ROUTER=exp WEIGHT=180000 DURATION=1800
run pr210/kit_round.sh RUN=k{R} VARIANT=k{R}-pmtp-w0 CONC=88 ROUTER=exp WEIGHT=0 DURATION=1800
run pr210/kit_round.sh RUN=k{R}r VARIANT=k{R}-repro CONC=88 ROUTER=image
